name: phishing-investigation
description: Template for investigating reported phishing emails and campaigns

tasks.title: Email Analysis
tasks.description:
## Email Header & Content Analysis

- [ ] Collect original email with headers
- [ ] Analyze email headers (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
- [ ] Extract sender information
- [ ] Review email content and formatting
- [ ] Identify social engineering techniques
- [ ] Document suspicious elements

tasks.title: URL Analysis
tasks.description:
## URL Analysis

- [ ] Extract all URLs from email
- [ ] Defang URLs for safe handling
- [ ] Submit to URL scanning services
- [ ] Analyze landing pages (sandbox)
- [ ] Check domain registration/WHOIS
- [ ] Identify credential harvesting pages

tasks.title: Attachment Analysis
tasks.description:
## Attachment Analysis

- [ ] Safely extract attachments
- [ ] Calculate file hashes
- [ ] Submit to malware sandboxes
- [ ] Perform static analysis
- [ ] Document malware capabilities
- [ ] Extract IOCs from attachments

tasks.title: Impact Assessment
tasks.description:
## Determine Impact

- [ ] Identify all recipients
- [ ] Determine who clicked links
- [ ] Identify credential submissions
- [ ] Check for malware execution
- [ ] Assess data exposure risk
- [ ] Document affected users

tasks.title: Containment
tasks.description:
## Containment Actions

- [ ] Block sender address/domain
- [ ] Block malicious URLs at proxy
- [ ] Remove emails from all mailboxes
- [ ] Reset compromised credentials
- [ ] Block attachment hashes
- [ ] Disable compromised accounts

tasks.title: User Notification
tasks.description:
## User Communication

- [ ] Notify affected users
- [ ] Provide guidance on actions taken
- [ ] Issue password reset if needed
- [ ] Document user interactions
- [ ] Provide phishing awareness tips

tasks.title: Threat Intelligence
tasks.description:
## Threat Intel Activities

- [ ] Search for related campaigns
- [ ] Check threat intel feeds
- [ ] Identify threat actor (if possible)
- [ ] Document campaign indicators
- [ ] Update internal threat intel

tasks.title: Remediation & Closure
tasks.description:
## Remediation & Closure

- [ ] Verify all containment actions
- [ ] Update email filtering rules
- [ ] Add IOCs to blocklists
- [ ] Complete incident documentation
- [ ] Consider user awareness training
- [ ] Share IOCs if appropriate
